launch.selection: Use runtime-native-code-qa-mcp only when all seven required tools are exposed and overall_health succeeds. Otherwise preserve state and block Workspace Learning Pro Phase 3; exact-ref uncertainty does not authorize another transport.

authentication.missing_behavior: Preserve state and block Workspace Learning Pro Phase 3. Never request or inject desktop or CLI credentials and never select a CLI fallback.

code-qa.ask.purpose: Start a fresh CodeQA task using a prompt that carries repository, requested branch, and expected SHA because the MCP operation has no branch field.

code-qa.continue_task.purpose: Continue a successful MCP-started CodeQA conversation without changing its bound transport.

code-qa.get_task.purpose: Read task status and structured result for lifecycle polling and continuity.

code-qa.get_task_logs.purpose: Read bounded task execution logs for result retrieval and failure diagnosis.

code-qa.cancel_task.purpose: Cancel an exact live MCP-started task only when cancellation is explicitly authorized; a PENDING task additionally requires task and execution-log evidence that recursive/delegated work caused the stall, never status or elapsed time alone.

code-qa.health.purpose: Verify CodeQA MCP health before selecting it as the conversation transport.

code-qa.list_conversations.purpose: Reconcile a reserved but unbound dispatch intent against the runtime-authenticated user's conversations before any further dispatch.

data_policy.external_mutation: CodeQA task lifecycle only; cancellation requires explicit authorization, and cancelling a PENDING task requires task-plus-log evidence of a recursive/delegated-work stall.
data_policy.transport_continuity: Every new task, continuation, and recovery uses native MCP and a persisted pre-dispatch intent. A pre-existing legacy CLI task may be observed read-only only until terminal; it cannot be created, continued, resumed, cancelled, or recovered through CLI.
data_policy.dispatch_guarantee: Fail closed with at most one automatic dispatch per unresolved intent; this does not claim exactly-once provider execution.
